_note: The ONE status -> error-envelope code table. Machine-readable twin of the vocabulary docs/design/api-error-envelope.md describes in prose and server/ocserverd/server.go's errorCodeForStatus implements. Three consumers read THIS file, none re-declares the table: (1) frontend/src/api/errorCodes.ts (codeForStatus, the only source of a code on the mock seam), (2) server/ocserverd's TestErrorCodeForStatusMatchesSpec (cell-by-cell against errorCodeForStatus, fallbacks included), (3) conformance/test_error_envelope.py (CODE_BY_STATUS). Changing the server's map without changing this file reddens (2); changing this file without the frontend reddens the frontend guard.
